# HELP podium_provider_score Median podium score across this provider's usable streams -- the same 0..1 number that decides ranking. Quality of what works; the state family carries how much of it works.
# TYPE podium_provider_score gauge
podium_provider_score{provider="Provider B",stat="median"} 0.51
# HELP podium_provider_verdict_age_seconds Age of the verdicts this provider is being judged on. A provider whose lane runs at its limit is probed least often, so its numbers are the stalest.
# TYPE podium_provider_verdict_age_seconds gauge
podium_provider_verdict_age_seconds{provider="Provider B",stat="median"} 35281
podium_provider_verdict_age_seconds{provider="Provider B",stat="max"} 35469
